Name: Better Beach Forage
Author: strobel1ght
Description:
This mod makes the beach less sparse by increasing the spawn rate of regular beach forage items.

—Features—
[list]
[*]Increases spawn rate of beach forage.
[*]Same spawn distributed across left and right side so there is no discrepancy.
[*]Adds seaweed drop chance.
[*]Adds crabs to the beach which have a 50% chance to drop a Crab.
[/list]
—Mod Prerequisites—
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI
[/url]- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]

—Installation—
Place the folder [b]Better Beach Forage[/b] in /Mods

Everyone else at on the Stardew Valley Discord channel with their feedback!
